root_cause: The poll's transition dedupe was applied to `kick_probe`/`kick_offline` only; the refusal branch returned before `KO.kickPollSig` was written, so a sustained refusal emitted one identical row per 20 s poll and a conclusive answer after a refusal emitted nothing. A row that repeats every tick is a sample, and a transition the ring cannot see is a missing answer.
enforced_by: kick-overlay/content-fix-test.cjs W6b (refusal dedupe + refused->answered RED) via the content-fix gate check

attempts.action: `kickRefusal(k, opts)` logs only when `opts.log !== false`; new `kickRefusalKey(k)` returns `ref:N`/`ok`; `probeKickLayer` computes `pollSig` (now including `kickRefusalKey`) BEFORE the refusal branch, sets `KO.kickPollSig`, passes `{log: pollChanged}` to the refusal logger and keeps the `at:'poll'` transition row after it. Arm W6b asserts identical-refusal dedupe, the refused->answered transition, and its RED mutant (pre-fix `kickRefusal(k)`) writes two rows.
attempts.rationale: The caller owns whether an outcome is a transition; the logger owns only the text, so the flag has to be passed, not re-derived.
